_comment: Class definitions. Adding a class here must require ZERO GDScript changes - that is a v0.2 acceptance criterion. The Synthetic class was added after the format was written and is the live proof of that. The bonuses dict is deliberately sparse: the format carries far more than v0.2 populates.

_bonus_keys.repair_speed_mult: multiplier on this crew member's own repair rate
_bonus_keys.repair_speed_mult_others: multiplier on ALL OTHER crew's repair rate while this one is alive
_bonus_keys.repair_points_per_tick: damage points removed per repair interval (default 1)
_bonus_keys.fire_damage_taken_mult: multiplier on fire damage taken by this crew member
_bonus_keys.evasion_flat_bonus: flat percentage of evasion added while manning Engines
_bonus_keys.medbay_heal_mult: multiplier on Medbay heal rate while manning it
_bonus_keys.man_bonus_mult: multiplier on this crew member's manning bonus
_bonus_keys.weapon_charge_mult: multiplier on charge speed of weapons in this room
_bonus_keys.can_repair_synthetics: may restore a DISABLED synthetic by standing in its room
_bonus_keys.hack_skill: v0.3 only - intrusion capability, unused in v0.2

_colour_rule: Draw colour for this class's crew marker. Content, not balance — but it lives here so that adding a seventh class stays a JSON-only change, per GAME_SPEC_v0.2 §4.

classes.label: Commander
classes.description: The captain. One per ship. Cannot be replaced or dismissed.

classes.label: Soldier
classes.description: Fighter. Boarding combat is not built yet, so the bonuses below are all this class currently does. How strong it should end up is an open question - do not treat any figure here as settled.

classes.label: Engineer
classes.description: Keeps it flying. The only class that can restore a disabled synthetic.

classes.label: Pilot
classes.description: Mans Engines. Turns reactor power into not being hit.

classes.label: Medic
classes.description: Mans the medical slot. How this class sits alongside a Clone Bay is an open question and not yet decided.

classes.label: Synthetic
classes.description: Combat frame with an intrusion suite. Does not bleed out and does not die on a timer - at 0 HP it goes DISABLED and waits. Cannot be healed by a Medbay or restored by a Clone Bay; only an Engineer can bring it back. Its XP is never lost, because there is no pattern to reset. Hacking is v0.3.

classes.label: Boarder
classes.description: Not a playable class. Pirates who came aboard. Same suit as the crew, told apart by colour, which is also how the enemy ship's crew are drawn - a separate model is a want, not a need. No bonuses: they have no mechanics of their own yet, only presence and movement.
